execution.signal_timing: causal component signals on closed bars
execution.rotation: calendar-month open using returns strictly before allocation day

selection.rule: on 2024-2025 require positive return, at least half of months positive, and daily-close max drawdown no worse than 35%; rank by 25% month coverage, positive months, worst month, return, and drawdown

decision.reason: The development-selected adaptive portfolio did not pass confirmation monthly return, drawdown, and cost-stress gates.

limitations: 2026 has been viewed in prior studies and is not a fresh independent holdout.
Joint portfolio drawdown is measured at daily closes, not every component bar.
Monthly allocation turnover is modeled, but cross-margin liquidation is not.
Market impact and exchange failure are not modeled.
